ownFormulationExactPreserved.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann zu einem beobachtbaren Alltags- oder Technikphänomen eine chemisch untersuchbare Frage und eine durch Beobachtungen prüfbare Hypothese selbst formulieren, die Hypothese begründen und angeben, welcher erwartbare Befund dafür oder dagegen spräche.
ownFormulationExactPreserved.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can independently formulate a chemically investigable question and an observation-testable hypothesis about an observable everyday or technological phenomenon, justify the hypothesis and specify an expected finding that would support or contradict it.
ownFormulationExactPreserved.sourceRouteObligation: Own production remains compulsory wherever the original reviewed route requires it; supplied hypotheses do not satisfy this separate product.

ownFormulationExactPreserved.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann aus einer Alltags- oder Techniksituation selbst eine chemisch untersuchbare Fragestellung identifizieren und formulieren, unter Verwendung geeigneter Konzepte oder Theorien eine prüfbare Hypothese selbst formulieren und begründen, daraus einen erwartbaren Befund ableiten und erklären, wie ein geeigneter Gegenbefund der Hypothese widersprechen würde.
ownFormulationExactPreserved.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can independently identify and formulate a chemically investigable question from an everyday or technological situation, formulate and justify a testable hypothesis using appropriate concepts or theories, derive an expected finding and explain how a suitable counter-finding would contradict the hypothesis.
ownFormulationExactPreserved.sourceRouteObligation: Own production remains compulsory wherever the original reviewed route requires it; supplied hypotheses do not satisfy this separate product.

mandatoryOriginalSourceRouteChecks.principle: The existence of a formulation product without a universal hard prerequisite does not waive that product from a route that requires it. Source obligations attach to the reviewed target/route, rather than imposing mastery of own formulation on every practical case.
mandatoryOriginalSourceRouteChecks.lowerC8C9ModelContributions: Retained as partial earlier source contributions, with their actual final stage/target route not approved here. A lower hypothesis-free case cannot complete the strengthened hypothesis-guided final model product.
mandatoryOriginalSourceRouteChecks.qualitativeAndQuantitative: Both contexts still mandatory in the national extended practical product; original BY alternative contributions are not mechanically relabeled exact.
mandatoryOriginalSourceRouteChecks.modelBasedAlternative: Actual model testing remains separate from practical execution; no universal experiment+model AND completion is invented.
